description:
Blank Audio Cassette Tape Lot  13 Tapes
Mixed Brands, 1980s-1990s
TDK, Maxell, Realistic, Certron
A diverse collection of thirteen blank audio cassette tapes featuring leading magnetic media brands from the late 20th century. This lot is notable for containing a high proportion of factory-sealed vintage stock, which remains highly sought after by analog recording enthusiasts for their specific sonic characteristics and period-correct aesthetics. The selection spans various formulations including standard Normal Bias and high-performance Chrome-equivalent tapes.
9 Factory-Sealed tapes and 4 unsealed/opened tapes
Mix of 60-minute and 90-minute recording lengths
Includes Type I (Normal Bias) and Type II (Chrome/High Bias) formulations
Features TDK D90, Maxell UR series, and Realistic Supertape HD-90
Condition:
Nine tapes are factory sealed in original cellophane; several wrappers exhibit light shelf wear, minor corner scuffs, or remnants of vintage retail price stickers. Four tapes are unsealed and housed in standard clear protective cases; the recording status and internal J-card condition of these opened tapes have not been verified. Clear plastic cases on unsealed units show typical surface scuffing and light scratches from storage. Realistic Supertape and one Maxell XLII-S represent the Type II High-Bias media in this collection.
Please Read:
All items are donated and may exhibit signs of wear, including surface dirt, discoloration, scratches, and scuffs. Glassware and dishes may display color fading, crazing, or chips. Clothing items may have loose threads or fabric pilling. The full functionality of electrical items is not guaranteed. Purses may show wear on the bottom edges, corners, and handles. Jewelry metal content and stones have not been tested unless explicitly stated, and stones have not been individually inspected. Items sold in lots have not been counted or sorted and may contain small or damaged pieces. Returns are not accepted for these items.

Combined Shipping Temporarily Unavailable:
Item combining is
temporarily unavailable while we transition to a new system
. During this time, orders must be shipped individually and cannot be combined for reduced shipping charges. We appreciate your patience and understanding as we complete this update. Once our new system is fully in place, combined shipping options may become available again.

Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:
Product Overview:
This lot contains a variety of mineral and rock specimens including polished and raw geodes, agate slices, quartz crystals, and semi-precious stones. The specimens display natural banding, druzy crystal formations, and include pieces with polished faces and rough exteriors.

Specifications:
- Includes blue, pink, and clear agate slices, one with a metal hook
- Contains rough pieces with crystalline interiors
- Features tumbled and raw rose quartz
- Contains geode cross-sections showing natural formations
- Total weight approximately 10 lbs

Each piece varies in size, shape, and coloration. The collection is suitable for mineral collectors and educational purposes.

description:
Wahl Signature
Gold Filled Ring Top Fountain Pen
Early 20th Century
This vintage Wahl Signature fountain pen features a gold-filled case with a classic chased geometric pattern. Produced during the golden age of American writing instruments, this "ring top" model was designed for portability, intended to be worn on a watch chain or chatelaine. The nib is clearly marked "Wahl Signature Pen 14K," identifying the high-quality gold content characteristic of these premium writing tools. The barrel is personalized with the engraved name "E. BURKLE."
Wahl Signature 14K gold nib (tested and marked)
Vintage gold filled case with decorative chased design
Ring top attachment for chain or lanyard use
Lever-filler mechanism for ink loading
Approximately 3.75 inches in length
Condition:
Vintage condition with visible signs of age and use. The gold-filled surface shows a natural aged patina and minor surface scratches; no significant dents or plating loss observed on the exterior. The personalized engraving "E. BURKLE" is deep and legible. The internal section shows significant ink residue and oxidation at the threads and section joint. The nib shows surface wear and staining but remains structurally intact. The filling mechanism has not been restored; functionality of the internal ink sac is unknown and should be assumed to require service for writing use.
Warehouse Location: Canton
Due to our lighting, white glare lines may appear on items - This is NOT damage
If you have any questions regarding the quality or authenticity of this item or general questions regarding and item, please click Contact Seller on the item page and send us a message. We are available to answer your questions Monday through Friday, 8 am - 3:00 pm, EST.

Some items may contain unseen flaws not noted in the description.
See Photos. Items sold as-is.

description:
Product Overview:
This is a polished Orthoceras fossil specimen featuring a well-preserved orthoconic shell embedded in a natural matrix. The fossil shows the characteristic segmented, linear structure with alternating dark and light bands.

Specifications:
- Fossil Type: Orthoceras (extinct marine cephalopod)
- Shell: Partially polished on one side to reveal details
- Matrix: Medium brown stone with mineral inclusions and rough texture
- Shell Structure: Segmented, linear with alternating dark and light bands
- Condition: No major visible damage
- Finish: Back and edges remain unpolished

Additional Information:
The specimen combines polished and natural surfaces, highlighting the shell within its matrix.

Description:
Discover the raw beauty of nature with this curated lot of 10 natural mineral specimens, including geodes, agate, and an eye-catching amethyst cluster. Each geode has been split to reveal its glittering inner crystals, showcasing an array of textures and muted gray-to-clear hues. The agate specimen displays striking natural patterns, while the amethyst offers vibrant purple crystals for contrast. These rough, unpolished stones are ideal for collectors, display, or educational purposes, offering a peek into geological wonders. The variety of formations and colors provides visual interest for any setting, whether as unique decor or part of a gemstone collection. All stones are hand-selected for quality and visual appeal. No enhancements have been applied, ensuring each piece is as found in nature. Please review photos for exact details and condition. This assorted lot is a perfect addition for rock hounds, hobbyists, or anyone drawn to Earth's unique treasures.
